name: Daring Choices
source:
The winter prom is approaching and it's high time to find a date! Today's the big day, all you have to do is ask Theo.

Let's hope it's not too late...

[From [url=https://neven-vn.itch.io/daring-choices]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冬季舞会即将来临，是时候寻找约会对象了！今天是个大日子，你所要做的就是问西奥。

让我们希望还不算太晚……

[来自[url=https://neven-vn.itch.io/daring-choices]Itch.io[/url]]
